<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="rnnbg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#1a0407"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#0d0203"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#040101"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="rnnglow" cx="0.28" cy="0.4" r="0.62">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e11d2a" stop-opacity="0.30"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#e11d2a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rnnmetal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#e9e9ee"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#c3c3cc"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f4f4f7"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="rnniris" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.6">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe58a"/><stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#f5a623"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b5560c"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#rnnbg)"/>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#rnnglow)"/>

  <!-- CRT scanlines -->
  <g stroke="#2a0a0d" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35">
    <line x1="0" y1="48" x2="640" y2="48"/><line x1="0" y1="96" x2="640" y2="96"/><line x1="0" y1="144" x2="640" y2="144"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="192" x2="640" y2="192"/><line x1="0" y1="240" x2="640" y2="240"/><line x1="0" y1="288" x2="640" y2="288"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== EMBLEM: raptor-eye roundel in a radiating broadcast burst ===== -->
  <g transform="translate(146,150)">
    <!-- radiating broadcast rays -->
    <g fill="#e11d2a" opacity="0.5">
      <g id="ray"><path d="M0 -118 L9 -150 L-9 -150 Z"/></g>
      <use href="#ray" transform="rotate(30)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(60)"/>
      <use href="#ray" transform="rotate(90)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(120)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(150)"/>
      <use href="#ray" transform="rotate(180)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(210)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(240)"/>
      <use href="#ray" transform="rotate(270)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(300)"/><use href="#ray" transform="rotate(330)"/>
    </g>
    <!-- roundel -->
    <circle r="104" fill="#0b0203" stroke="#e11d2a" stroke-width="5"/>
    <circle r="92" fill="none" stroke="#c9a34a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- raptor eye: heavy predatory brow over a burning iris -->
    <ellipse cx="0" cy="6" rx="78" ry="52" fill="#160406" stroke="#7a1016" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="4" r="34" fill="url(#rnniris)"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="4" r="15" fill="#0b0203"/>
    <circle cx="-9" cy="-5" r="5" fill="#fff" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- angry brow ridge -->
    <path d="M-82 -34 Q-30 -60 6 -40 Q60 -20 84 -44 L84 -70 L-82 -70 Z" fill="#0b0203"/>
    <path d="M-78 -30 Q-28 -54 6 -36" fill="none" stroke="#e11d2a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- beak hook -->
    <path d="M60 8 Q92 14 84 40 Q78 30 60 30 Z" fill="#c9a34a"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ===== WORDMARK LOCKUP ===== -->
  <text x="300" y="150" fill="url(#rnnmetal)" font-size="86" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="1">RAPTOR</text>
  <rect x="302" y="168" width="300" height="5" fill="#e11d2a"/>
  <text x="304" y="200" fill="#e11d2a" font-size="23" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="10">NEWS NETWORK</text>
  <text x="304" y="230" fill="#c9a34a" font-size="14.5" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="5">FAIR · BALANCED · RELENTLESS</text>

  <!-- ===== BREAKING BAND ===== -->
  <rect x="0" y="316" width="640" height="44" fill="#b3121d"/>
  <rect x="0" y="316" width="640" height="3" fill="#f5b300"/>
  <rect x="14" y="328" width="86" height="20" fill="#0b0203"/>
  <text x="20" y="343" fill="#f5b300" font-size="13" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="2">LIVE</text>
  <text x="112" y="343" fill="#fff" font-size="16" font-weight="800" letter-spacing="3">WE REPORT. YOU COMPLY.</text>
  <text x="624" y="343" fill="#ffdede" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="2" text-anchor="end">NIGHTLY FURY</text>
</svg>
